Title: Migrate budget export worker to managed identity
Description: Current export worker still references legacy secret rotation flow.
Impact: Credential management risk and audit overhead.
SuggestedRemediation: Switch to managed identity and remove shared secret usage.

Title: Refactor challenge aggregation query
Description: Current aggregation query causes latency during peak activity periods.
Impact: Dashboard load time exceeds 4 seconds in large sites.
SuggestedRemediation: Introduce indexed filter strategy and cached rollups.

Title: Increase test coverage for runbook parsing
Description: Critical parser paths have limited unit coverage.
Impact: Higher regression risk for parser updates.
SuggestedRemediation: Add deterministic parser fixtures and CI assertions.

Title: Define portal integration reference architecture
Description: Portal requires a formal integration blueprint across dependent services.
Impact: Unclear integration boundaries may slow release readiness.
SuggestedRemediation: Publish target architecture and data-flow artifacts.
